ella_cs: NebulaCare reports item INV-NEB-3311 showing a large burst charge after region failover on 2026-04-07. they say traffic briefly hit our backup apac cluster and costs spiked. can finance review for credit?
diego_billing: quick numbers: reserved_commit=150k token-hrs, burst=68k token-hrs, burst_charge=$12,879 (68,000 x $0.189). spike window ~2026-04-07 01:45-06:30 UTC. routing shows two failover entries.
ledger-bot: auto-note: failover cause = autoscaler jitter + preemption; incident ref INC-APAC-7122.
ella_cs: customer says they couldn't route traffic differently in time. asking for full burst waiver + reversal of late fee.
priya_finance: SLA covers availability credits but not explicit burst-waivers. we can approve discretionary goodwill but need clear rationale and approval trail. what does AE say?
tom_ae: NebulaCare is strategic. recommend partial credit tied to confirmation it's a platform failover and that they won't reuse as precedent. propose 40% credit on burst line.
priya_finance: 40% credit = $5,151.6. finance OK pending incident verification and CS confirmation. prepare audit note: "Finance approves one-time goodwill credit of $5,151.60 for NebulaCare (INV-NEB-3311), contingent on postmortem and customer acknowledgement."
diego_billing: will prepare CreditMemo:-$5,151.60 but hold posting. tag reason_code=GOODWILL_FAILOVER.
ella_cs: i'll send the offer and request acknowledgement. postmortem ETA 72h from infra.
ledger-bot: reminder: attach postmortem and tag ledger entries before month close.
priya_finance: agreed. document outcome once resolved; sales-ops to be cc'd for precedent tracking.
ella_cs: will update thread when customer responds. :white_check_mark:
